definition: L5 (Verified) = an actor whose Kotoba resources + fields (+ enums where applicable) have been reconciled against the platform's OFFICIAL public API documentation, with provenance recorded here. L5 is a stricter bar than L4 (production pattern); it asserts real-API fidelity, not just implementation completeness.
method: Each resource verified by fetching the official object-reference page (WebFetch) and confirming the generated schema's fields exist on the real object; discovered enums recorded; un-modeled real fields recorded as gaps (the generated schema is a faithful SUBSET, never inventing fields absent from the real API).
